description: Use this when a visitor asks whether or when a ride broke down: with ride_id, each outage of that ride over the last 1 to 30 days with start and end times; without ride_id, every outage at the park today including rides down right now. Outages come from Disney's and Universal's own live feeds.

days.description: Days of one ride's history, 1 to 30; defaults to 7. Ignored without ride_id.

park_id.description: Canonical Parky park ID from parky_find_experience (a park key such as magic-kingdom also works).

ride_id.description: Optional canonical ride ID for one ride's outage history.

name: parky_get_ride_outages
title: Get ride outages
